description: West Coast Ocean Data Portal is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by West Coast Ocean Alliance. The West Coast Governors Alliance on Ocean Health supports this collection of resources. Their goal is to increase discovery and connectivity of ocean and coastal data to better inform regional resource management, policy development, and ocean planning. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Flooding – Coastal. Assets: Energy and Utilities, Natural Areas and Wildlife. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
